title: YNX Social — Private conversations and user-controlled feeds
metaDescription: Connect through consent-based profiles, device-bound encrypted conversations and user-controlled social feeds.
h1: Social connection with explicit privacy controls
risks: Production-signed mobile builds are not available.

faq.question: Can people find me by wallet address?
faq.answer: No. Wallet addresses are not a Social discovery surface.

faq.question: Is the mobile app publicly released?
faq.answer: No. The current build is a locally tested integration candidate.
